question: Which king named Śāla is born after the end of Śikhidhvaja?
premises: A time is marked as the end of Śikhidhvaja.
A person is born after that time.
That person becomes a king named Śāla.
inference: A king named Śāla arises after the end of Śikhidhvaja.
plain_english: After the end of Śikhidhvaja, one born would be a king named Śāla.
